title: Ratchet & Clank (PAL, SCES_509.16), SN ProDG ee-gcc 2.95.3 (v1.14) + SN ps2eeas
setup: mkdir -p baserom && ln -sf {retail} baserom/SCES_509.16 && G={work}/sn24/local/sce/ee/gcc && rm -rf {work}/sn24 toolchain && mkdir -p $G/bin $G/lib/gcc-lib/ee toolchain && ln -sf {tool:ee-gcc2.95.3-114}/bin/ee-gcc.exe $G/bin/ee-gcc2953.exe && ln -sf {tool:ee-gcc2.9-991111}/bin/ee-gcc.exe $G/bin/ee-gcc.exe && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.95.3-114}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.3 $G/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.3 && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.9-991111}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.9-ee-991111 $G/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.9-ee-991111 && ln -sfn {work}/sn24 toolchain/sn-prodg-24 && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.9-991111-01} toolchain/ee-gcc-2.9-991111-01
limits: Ratchet & Clank PAL (OpenRAC rac1-decomp): the repo's Makefile.sn is run with `make -n -B` for each object of `config/core_text.objects` / `text.objects` that has a `src/core|game/*.c` source; the recipe it prints (the SN compiler, the repo's python rewriting steps, the SN assembler) is the unit's command. The SN ProDG compilers are the pinned `ee-gcc2.95.3-114` (v1.14: the repo's `toolchain/sn-prodg-24` = AngheloAlf/sce_ps2_sdk_24, same cc1.exe sha1 6c232dd6...) and `ee-gcc2.9-991111`/`-01`, run under wibo (`WINE=wibo`) instead of wine; libgcc and data objects, which have no single C source, are not units of this lane.

SN ProDG's EE gcc 2.95.3 has a 128-bit `long long` (`sizeof(long long)` is not 8 and any arithmetic on it is "unsupported wide integer operation"): its 64-bit integer type is `long`. romwright and m2c both print the 64-bit type as `long long`, so for units compiled with that compiler the harness rewrites `long long` to `long` in the composed source (prelude, context and candidate). Without it a quarter of the candidates fail to compile whatever else they say.
